A colourful infographic chart showing a large circle divided into eight slices, representing the 8 categories of Zakah recipients. Each slice contains an icon (e.g., a person with empty pockets for Al-Fuqara, a broken chain for Fir-Riqab, a traveller with a bag for Ibn as-Sabil) and the Arabic term alongside the English translation. A simple geographical map diagram of the Hajj locations. It shows Makkah (with a small Ka'bah icon), Mina (showing a cluster of tents), Arafah (showing a small hill, Mount of Mercy), and Muzdalifah in between Mina and Arafah. Dotted arrows show the path of the pilgrims starting from Makkah to Mina, to Arafah, back to Muzdalifah, then Mina, and finally back to Makkah.
